playerReference.phases:
1. Draw 3 energy cards.
2. Play 3 energy cards.
3. Do the following in any order:
  a. Spend any played energy.
  b. Use any devices not discovered this turn.
  c. While in C.o.G., spend 2 
  d. ONCE, while not in C.o.G. either:
    - Discover an artifact from the row,
       -OR-
    - Complete a device, attaching ALL its components.
4. Draw or discard to your hand size, if needed.

setupText:
* Give each player a "Raygun", "Toolbox", and "HEV Suit". Set the other starts aside.
* Deal a "Tiltch Cell", "Yonar Pulsar", and "Naxatu Assembly" to discover row.
* If you are playing with 2 players, remove "Dominator", "Doomsdayer", and "Dimensional Harmonizer".
* Shuffle the artifact deck. Deal one more artifact to create the discover row.
* Shuffle the energy deck and place it somewhere accessible.
* Search the component deck for all starter components and components for artifacts in the discover row. 
* Place the rest of the component deck next to the artifact deck.
* Each player draws 5 energy and sets a health counter to 20.
* Place 3 sets of different color tokens somewhere accessible, for stored energy.
generalText: Magnum Opus is an Elder-punk engine builder at the Center of the Galaxy (C.o.G.). Each player is a skilled scientist seeking to complete the work of one of three Elder races, whatever the consequences.
